admission_lifecycle_contracts.ai: Native AI review reads only the selected bounded source snapshot, checks cancellation/account lifetime, and uses the configured provider plus source-revision cache. Read/decode tools never execute the plugin.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.bridge-read: BridgeServices validates C-supplied identity/owner and the named query arguments, then reads PermissionsModel. The strict SDK Bool query fails closed on a malformed or unavailable native result; it allocates no presentation or callback lease.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.cleanup: Revoke only a stored resource belonging to the immutable plugin/owner token. Cleanup during retiring unload is allowed; a destroyed/stale owner fails at Host. Duplicate terminal cleanup is idempotent; no replacement-owner lookup or new effect is admitted.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.host: Runtime/PluginHost owns lifecycle admission, maintenance exclusion and captured interpreter handles. Native storage/manager work stays native; operations invoking Python use its captured interpreter mailbox. Native manager actions await their actual result. This does not export arbitrary manager methods to plugins.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.logging: C supplies the log owner. The native bounded log buffer validates level/message/traceback data as applicable and appends a record. Logging creates no settings transaction or callback lease; Android rotating-file output is outside this route.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.menu: Menu registration/replacement commits under the native lease-store lock with captured owner/account/execution. Gesture delivery rechecks source controller, context, revision and owner; five native placements and the bounded condition grammar are authoritative.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.native: NativeServices bridge requests validate operation/model and immutable owner, with operation-specific grants and account scope. Callback-producing operations reserve bounded leases before async work; interception queries inspect existing stored registrations. Actual callback execution rechecks control, terminal delivery precedes FIFO retirement, and cancellation has an explicit winner.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.owner-work: The native scheduler captures the immutable interpreter owner before asynchronous hops and reserves callback ownership before publication. Work runs on that owner's mailbox; original SDK account context is carried by its wrapper. Cancellation/terminal delivery retain FIFO cleanup ownership. Named postToOwner delay is bounded to 0..86400000 ms; legacy runOnUIThread has its own nonnegative Int32 validation.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.renderer: MainActor native rendering projects a validated snapshot. Table/gesture/layout methods are counterpart roles, not Android View/Canvas implementations. Settings actions additionally require the captured settings permit. No recorded-frame equivalence is claimed.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.sdk: Interpreter-local SDK data/function. Installed adapters and owner context govern execution; this is not by itself a native provider operation.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.settings: Native-manager reads/actions capture owner, actual Int32 account slot and revocable page/read/action permit before Task/queue hops; Host checks them on the worker. Direct SDK serialization uses its already owned worker, not a newly acquired UI action permit. Schema refresh replaces callback ledgers; current callback failure rereads storage, stale/cancelled UI work does not.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.storage: Bridge requests validate the C-supplied plugin identity and immutable owner token. Settings/directory operations use PluginServiceStorage ID/key validation and locked atomic per-plugin JSON. Bulk JSON is opaque text; literal reserved keys remain data.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.tl: TL provider captures C owner, actual account, grants and parent execution guard before main/network work. Schema/peer namespaces, source-file access, recursion and commit permits are revalidated. Response/error is terminal and released in owner FIFO; enqueue is not upload/server delivery.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.transform: Host awaiting event queue captures interpreter generations and account. SDK exact/substr priority ledger selects callbacks; native schema normalizes each replacement, preserves prior valid input on failure and enforces cancel/final semantics before request/update application.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.ui: C worker validates owner/UI permission and captures parent execution before main/readback hops. Native admission rechecks owner/account/revision; retained effects keep budget until actual drain. Presentation visibility is native; callback-producing leases deliver closed before captured-owner FIFO release. Refresh/readback need no invented user callback.
admission_lifecycle_contracts.value: Value/model mapping only. No native effect, Java method export or mutable shared-registry capability follows from this anchor.
